# appgatesdp_admin_mfa_settings (Data Source)

Supported SDP Admin API versions: v21, v22, v23, v24, v25.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `exempted_users` (List of String) List of users to be excluded from MFA during admin login.
- `id` (String) ID of the object.
- `provider_id` (String) The MFA provider ID to use during Multi-Factor Authentication. If null, Admin MFA is disabled.
